__inputs.description: Connexion au rôle de supervision (lecture seule) sur la base mistral
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL MISTRAL
__inputs.name: DS_MISTRAL

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(ts) AS time, count(*)/15.0 AS points_min FROM mesures WHERE ts >= (SELECT max(ts) - interval '15 minutes' FROM mesures);

SELECT g.famille, max(m.ts) AS dernier_point, (SELECT max(ts) FROM mesures) - max(m.ts) AS anciennete FROM mesures m JOIN affectation_capteur af ON af.series_id = m.series_id JOIN signaux g ON g.signal_id = af.signal_id WHERE m.ts >= (SELECT max(ts) - interval '1 hour' FROM mesures) GROUP BY 1;

panels.title: M2 · Ancienneté du dernier point, par famille de flux

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'mistral_1min' AS agregat, (SELECT max(ts) FROM mesures) - max(seau) AS retard FROM mistral_1min UNION ALL SELECT 'mistral_1h', (SELECT max(ts) FROM mesures) - max(seau) FROM mistral_1h UNION ALL SELECT 'mistral_1j', (SELECT max(ts) FROM mesures) - max(seau) FROM mistral_1j;

panels.title: M3 · Retard de rafraîchissement par agrégat

targets.rawSql: SELECT hypertable_name, count(*) AS chunks FROM timescaledb_information.chunks GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT round(before_compression_total_bytes::numeric / nullif(after_compression_total_bytes,0), 1) AS ratio, (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_compressed)::float / count(*) FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name = 'mesures') AS part_rowstore FROM hypertable_compression_stats('mesures');

panels.title: M5 · Ratio de compression / part rowstore

panels.description: Alerte A2 assise sur ce panneau (seuil relatif : 3 × la période, jobs déjà échus)

targets.rawSql: SELECT j.job_id, j.proc_name, j.scheduled, s.total_failures, now() - s.last_successful_finish AS depuis_dernier_succes FROM timescaledb_information.jobs j LEFT JOIN timescaledb_information.job_stats s USING (job_id);

panels.title: M6 · Jobs : échecs et dernier succès

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, pg_database_size(current_database()) AS octets;

panels.title: M7 · Taille de la base (tendance = alerte A4)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * blks_hit / nullif(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 2) AS cache_hit_pct FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();

panels.title: M8 · Taux de succès du cache
